concepts.def: 1950s movement: Osborne's Look Back in Anger 1956, Amis Lucky Jim 1954; class resentment, anti-establishment.
The Movement; plain diction, anti-modernist; ironic Englishness; 'Church Going', 'Whitsun Weddings'.
Confessional poetry; 'Daddy', 'Lady Lazarus'; published posthumously after 1963 suicide; Bell Jar same year.
Angela Carter's feminist fairy tale rewrites; subverts Bluebeard, Beauty and Beast; magical realism.
Bog poems use Iron Age bodies to address Northern Ireland Troubles; Catholic Irish poet; Nobel 1995.
Linton Kwesi Johnson, Grace Nichols; Patience Agbabi; reframes English tradition with Caribbean and African voices.
